pricing_framing: Lead with dollar savings in bold: "Save $63. Regular price $128, your price $65." Immediately below, add market context: "Brookline massage therapy typically $120–$205 — this is 46% below market." Place this messaging directly below the deal price display and above the package options. The merchant's own website (nomadorganicspa.com) lists this service at $128; Groupon matches their current promotional rate. Reference the 1,679 Groupon reviews (4.79★) as validation of service quality since no independent Yelp/Google data is available.
executive_summary: This page scores 6.7/10 overall, with the #1 issue being weak value communication (5/10): no original prices are shown, so customers cannot verify the claimed "Up to 22% Off" or see the $63 savings. The deal is strong — $65 vs. $128 regular price and 46% below the $120–$205 Brookline market — but the page doesn't communicate it. Adding clear original-price display, reframing against the validated market range, and filling critical booking gaps (hours, parking, cancellation specifics) could lift conversion 18–28%.
